title: GUARD (fixed in 44a3b4841c) — was: the `format` style's %F{...}/%f are printed literally by zshrs

retired.fix_commit_subject: zle: port the SIGWINCH redraw, printfmt's % escapes + erase-to-EOL, M-t's NUL-terminator read, and insert_positions' second cline_str walk
retired.why: zle: … item 2 — the same printfmt port. This fixture reached the defect through the `format` zstyle rather than `compadd -X`, so it is fixed by the same escape switch.
retired.evidence: re-verified first-hand by scripts/compsys_regressions.py under --variants: the fixture cell scored NOW-PASSES -> NOW-PASSES -> NOW-PASSES, and every variant and control of it came back n/a (no variants or controls). The runner reported the binary MOVED since the stamp (6420c23cecc13c35 -> 723088f811cdd366), which is the 'somebody fixed the bug' branch of the two the README names, not the 'the fixture was wrong' one.
retired.kept_because: a fixed bug is worth more as a guard than as a deleted file: the cell stays in the evidence base and the gate now FAILS if the divergence comes back.

guard_verified.against: /opt/homebrew/bin/zshrs -> Cellar/zshrs-all/0.12.49/bin/zshrs, the Homebrew-installed RELEASE build of the same version, 18273880 bytes, sha256 fb94500d8e1c32e7, built 2026-08-30 06:20:45 — before d555917f07 (08:04) and 44a3b4841c (08:32), so it still carries the bug

It reported CONTROL-MOVED and exited 1. The harness detail it produced there is the same one observed_when_diverging records, so the guard fails on THIS bug and not merely on some difference.
